title: Freqtrade README at captured commit
claim: Lists supported spot exchanges including Hyperliquid, dry-run, OHLCV backtesting and FreqAI integration.
limitations: Capability declarations; no strategy return independently reproduced.
project_implication: Use as optional benchmark; do not equate exchange support with arbitrary AMM routing.

title: FreqAI introduction
claim: FreqAI automates adaptive predictive modeling inside Freqtrade; the supplied example is explicitly not for production.
limitations: Training automation and forecasts are not evidence of profitability.
project_implication: Defer ML until a fixed non-ML baseline and evaluation protocol exist.

title: Freqtrade strategies README at captured commit
claim: Strategies are educational starting points; outcomes depend on pairs, period and timeframe.
limitations: No particular strategy and complete reproduced return series were validated here.
project_implication: Treat inspectable code alone as UNTESTED, not evidence Level 1.

title: Backtesting
claim: Fees apply on entry and exit; ordinary fills assume no slippage; current exchange limits are used.
limitations: OHLCV paths, historic limits and external dependencies are incomplete; sample tables are illustrative.
project_implication: Pin data/config/dependencies and stress fills, costs and universe selection.

title: Lookahead analysis
claim: Compares baseline and sliced backtests to detect lookahead effects.
limitations: Untriggered signals can evade checking; pairlist-dependent logic and limit orders can cause false positives.
conflict: Tool authors describe capabilities and caveats.
project_implication: Useful diagnostic; passing it cannot certify all leakage or real profitability.

title: Running FreqAI
claim: Sliding train/backtest windows emulate periodic retraining; features are calculated across the training timerange.
limitations: Feature code must still avoid future information; protocol can still be tuned repeatedly.
project_implication: Freeze windows and targets, log all trials, and separately protect untouched evaluation.

title: Exchange-specific Notes: Hyperliquid
claim: Documents API-wallet signing, limited historical candles and simulated market orders with a slippage bound.
limitations: Venue rules and history availability change; documentation also contains scope-dependent history warnings.
conflict: Connector maintainers; not a venue availability guarantee.
project_implication: No key or wallet now; verify exact market/history/order semantics before future adapter work.

title: FreqAI: generalizing adaptive modeling for chaotic time-series market forecasts
claim: Publishes and reviews the FreqAI software framework.
limitations: Software peer review does not establish an independently audited profitable strategy.
conflict: Authors develop the software under review.
project_implication: Cite for research architecture, never as a net-return certification.

title: Hummingbot README at captured commit
claim: Describes CEX/CLOB-DEX/AMM connectors, V2 controllers and separate Condor AI integration; reports aggregate volume.
limitations: Venue counts and volume are not net P&L; connector fidelity varies.
conflict: Foundation sponsorships and broker partnerships are disclosed.
project_implication: Reuse ideas and interface contracts; do not inherit a profitability claim.

title: Paper Trade
claim: Paper simulation exists for selected spot connectors and strategies without exchange credentials.
limitations: Large default virtual balances can conceal small-capital constraints; market data network is still needed.
project_implication: Explicitly model $100 and avoid assuming paper functionality implies prospective performance evidence.

title: Gateway DEX Middleware
claim: Standalone TypeScript REST middleware supports blockchain, Router, AMM and CLMM interactions.
limitations: It also manages wallets and is not itself a strategy or backtester.
conflict: Maintainer documentation and community-funded connector maintenance.
project_implication: Candidate future quote-only service behind a restricted adapter.

title: Gateway DEX Connectors
claim: Defines connector schemas and supported DEX integration architecture.
limitations: A supported protocol label is not universal token, pool, chain or fee support.
project_implication: Validate each chain/protocol/pool and quote schema separately.

title: Gateway issue 652: wallet endpoint hardening
claim: Reports wallet API exposure risks and an incident on the reporter's node; issue remained open.
limitations: Reporter claim, not independently verified loss; later hardening is included in captured release.
conflict: Public issue author report; no independent exploit reproduction.
conflicting_evidence: PR 659 is an ancestor of captured main; original report does not describe all current code.
project_implication: Keep signer absent from Arz; do not expose a future Gateway publicly.

title: Gateway PR 659: wallet security hardening
claim: Merged 2026-07-02; documents stronger keystore encryption, loopback defaults and optional API authentication.
limitations: A merged change is not a complete security audit.
conflicting_evidence: Follow-up issue 660 remains open; hardening documentation file was not present at captured main path.
project_implication: Pin fixes and review remaining threat boundaries before any signer deployment.

title: Gateway issue 660: remaining wallet security hardening
claim: Open follow-up tracks key-export, route lockout, passphrase rotation and mTLS considerations.
limitations: Open issue state alone does not prove every item remains exploitable.
conflicting_evidence: Captured wallet route registry has no explicit export route; README says raw keys are not returned.
project_implication: Resolve route-specific uncertainty before future live integration.

title: Hummingbot issue 8353: unsafe parsing surfaces
claim: Open report identifies unsafe evaluation/deserialization in Foxbit and remote order-book sources.
limitations: No exploit was run here; exposure depends on data-source control and runtime configuration.
conflict: Reporter assessment; static source checks provide separate corroboration.
project_implication: Exclude unnecessary upstream runtime and do not load untrusted serialized data.

title: OctoBot README at captured commit
claim: Lists UI, spot exchanges including Hyperliquid, LLM evaluators and new beta node architecture.
limitations: Beta feature completeness and exact connector behavior were not executed.
conflict: Vendor offers paid cloud products and uses affiliate links.
project_implication: UI alternative only; extra plugins and node architecture are unnecessary for initial harness.

title: OctoBot Backtesting
claim: Manual instances replay historical candles and use configured starting portfolios.
limitations: Candle-based order fills do not reconstruct complete order-book execution.
project_implication: Use explicit portfolio and execution assumptions if compared later.

title: OctoBot ChatGPT Trading
claim: GPT output acts as an evaluator; historical predictions are offered for selected cloud strategy pairs.
limitations: LLM backtests may be costly; historical prediction availability does not prove causal timestamps or calibration.
conflict: Vendor sells cloud features and may supply prediction history.
project_implication: Do not treat LLM confidence as probability; require timestamped immutable predictions and cost accounting.

title: Starting your OctoBot
claim: Node executes automations while running; manual instances support advanced research workflows.
limitations: Node identity wallet is explicitly not a cryptocurrency wallet; hosted interfaces add dependencies.
project_implication: Avoid wallet-like onboarding in Arz; keep original offline workflow simple.

title: Jesse README at captured commit
claim: Describes backtesting, research API, ML and MCP; reinforcement learning is marked coming soon.
limitations: Broad README features combine free core and commercial features.
project_implication: Do not classify roadmap items or paid features as free core capabilities.

title: Jesse Pricing
claim: Free tier includes backtesting and ML but excludes paper/DEX; Basic Lifetime is $899 at review.
limitations: Price, taxes and plan terms can change; no purchase made.
project_implication: Free research is possible; paid paper/live offering exceeds experimental capital envelope.

title: Jesse Machine Learning
claim: Documents gathering labels/features, training compatible estimators and using predictions in strategies.
limitations: Availability of a pipeline does not guarantee time-safe features, valid testing or returns.
project_implication: Evaluate only after data provenance and leak-free splits are specified.

title: LEAN README at captured commit
claim: Event-driven modular engine supports local builds and multi-market research/live workflows.
limitations: Readme promotes CLI convenience; setup and data can require more infrastructure.
conflict: Vendor operates commercial cloud and data services.
project_implication: Useful future multi-asset reference; no need to copy its architecture into a small MVP.

title: LEAN CLI Getting Started
claim: Official CLI requires membership in a paid-tier organization.
limitations: This requirement is distinct from the Apache-licensed engine source; no universal CLI price quoted.
project_implication: Do not promise the documented CLI path is free.

title: LEAN Scikit-Learn integration
claim: Shows ML library use within algorithms.
limitations: Integration examples are not independently verified trading performance.
project_implication: ML support is a capability column only.

title: LEAN dYdX brokerage model
claim: dYdX model supports crypto futures and uses margin account semantics.
limitations: Does not establish general DEX spot/AMM support.
project_implication: Exclude this connector from Arz's spot-only selection.

title: LEAN Coinbase brokerage model
claim: Coinbase cash-account model supports crypto trading and defined order types.
limitations: Model capability does not guarantee venue access or current fees.
project_implication: Evidence for spot capability, not a recommendation to open an account.

title: NautilusTrader README at captured commit
claim: Rust-native event engine unifies simulation/live strategies; v2 transition is active; built-in ML tooling is out of scope.
limitations: Shared code reduces but does not eliminate simulation/live differences or breaking changes.
conflict: Maintainer documentation with institutional commercial offering.
project_implication: Revisit only if event-level execution research justifies complexity.

title: NautilusTrader Hyperliquid integration
claim: Documents spot data/execution; testnet faucet setup notes mainnet deposit history requirement.

claim: Python DeFi engine supports backtesting/live DEX strategies and declares early beta.

title: Trading Strategy supported markets
claim: Lists decentralized exchanges and lending protocol market-data scope.
limitations: Market-data listing is not proof all live execution paths are supported.
project_implication: Separate data availability from execution capability and spot-only restrictions.

title: Deploying live trading strategies
claim: Documents strategy deployment infrastructure and operational integration.
limitations: Live deployment introduces RPC, key and transaction state responsibilities.
project_implication: Do not bring signer/deployment dependencies into no-wallet MVP.

title: The Probability of Backtest Overfitting
organization: Author-hosted manuscript; later Journal of Computational Finance
claim: Models selection overfitting and proposes combinatorially symmetric cross-validation.
limitations: Method depends on candidate return samples and assumptions; does not certify a new strategy.
conflict: Research authors; conflict assessment not independently performed.
project_implication: Record every trial; use multiple-testing diagnostics alongside chronological tests.

title: The Deflated Sharpe Ratio
organization: Author-hosted manuscript; Journal of Portfolio Management
claim: Adjusts performance inference for multiple testing and non-normal returns.
limitations: Requires sample information and an honest trial count; no Arz DSR estimated here.
conflict: Research authors; no independent conflict audit.
project_implication: Report uncertainty rather than selected maximum Sharpe.

title: scikit-learn Common pitfalls and recommended practices
claim: Train-only preprocessing prevents leakage; synthetic example changes apparent accuracy from 0.76 to 0.50.
limitations: Synthetic non-financial demonstration; not a trading result.
project_implication: Keep feature selection, imputation and scaling inside each training window.

title: scikit-learn TimeSeriesSplit
claim: Chronological folds and a gap parameter support ordered evaluation.
limitations: A gap alone does not discover overlapping labels, late publication or survivor selection.
project_implication: Purge based on label horizon and availability timestamps; preserve untouched final data.

title: Risks and Returns of Cryptocurrency
claim: Reports cryptocurrency-specific momentum associations; indexed text gives 0.33 percentage-point next-day and 3.16 next-week BTC effects per one-SD predictor move.
limitations: Historical regressions, not net executable ROI; full PDF direct fetch returned 403, indexed primary-source excerpts only.
conflict: Scholarly working paper; conflict assessment not independently performed.
project_implication: Motivates testing a momentum hypothesis, never importing a current profit forecast.
access_status: primary-source search excerpts verified; direct full PDF inaccessible

title: Solana Fees
